gs10.series: FRED GS10 — 10-Year Treasury constant maturity, monthly

cpi.series: FRED CPIAUCSL — CPI-U all items, SA, monthly

construction: real_yield = GS10 - CPI_YoY, then index shifted +2 months. Ex-post realised real yield, deliberately lagged; can understate a real-time signal but cannot create one.
cost_note: All trading costs are ASSUMED (bps), never measured.
